'''Scrapjaw Motito'''<ref name="Galaxy's Edge">{{GEAttr|Datapad}}</ref> was a diminutive [[scavenger]] who lived on the [[planet]] of [[Jakku]] approximately thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]]. One [[Standard day|day]], in [[Niima Outpost]], the scavenger came to disturb [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] while she was cleaning her latest findings at the [[washing table]]s speaking to her in an [[alien]] [[Language|dialect]]. Motito was overheard by the scavenger [[Hoogenz]], who laughed at what Motito said.<ref name="Episode VII" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Scrapjaw Motito first appeared in the [[2015]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']].<ref name="Episode VII" /> The character's name was first revealed by [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Pablo Hidalgo]] on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] in [[2016]],<ref name="Twit">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/685303084566863872|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=That is Scrapjaw Motito.|archivefile=File:Motito_tweet.png}}</ref> but would not be used in a [[canon]] source until [[2019]] when it appeared in the [[Datapad]] app available within the [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]] area of [[Disneyland]].<ref name="Galaxy's Edge" />
